ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 18, Compton-Getting corrected, Survival Probability corrected, ANTIRAM Median GDF MONO separated ENA Maps, Level H3, one-year Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and validated against SPASE 2.7.2, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 18 one-year ANTIRAM hydrogen ENA maps for the median GDF MONO separated-map product from the Release 18 Ribbon/GDF separation. Compton-Getting correction has been applied to account for spacecraft motion, and survival-probability correction has been applied to account for ENA losses during transport and to scale fluxes from the IBEX observing location near 1 AU to approximately 100 AU. The data cover 2009 through 2022, with measurement intervals spanning 2008-12-25 through 2022-12-26, on a 60 by 30 Solar Ecliptic longitude-latitude grid for IBEX-Hi energy channels 2-6. The channel 2-6 FWHM energy ranges are 0.52-0.95, 0.84-1.55, 1.36-2.50, 1.99-3.75, and 3.13-6.00 keV; the nominal energies are 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV. The source metadata identifies this as the median GDF separated-map variant using the mono-energy Compton-Getting-corrected representation. The CDF variables described by this record include differential flux and flux variance maps, together with virtual CDAWeb alternate views and Flux*_movie views. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R18_CG_SP_ANTIRAM_MEDIAN_GDF_MONO_1YR.

NumericalData.Caveats: Survival-probability correction has been applied to scale ENA fluxes from the IBEX observing location near 1 AU to approximately 100 AU, and Compton-Getting correction for spacecraft motion has been applied. This resource contains the median GDF component from the Release 18 Ribbon/GDF separation. The median map is the best-guess separated solution; the lower and upper maps are reasonable-value alternatives rather than formal statistical confidence intervals.
